chunks: By this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
Whoever conveys the message of a warrior is like one who has freed a slave, and he is his partner in the reward of his expedition.

key_terms.رقبة: Literally 'neck'; used idiomatically for a slave or bondsperson
key_terms.شريك: Partner, one who shares in the reward
key_terms.غاز: A warrior fighting in the way of Allah (ghazi)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for conveying a warrior's message in Islam?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) highlights the great merit of supporting those who fight in the path of Allah by conveying their messages back home. In the early Islamic community, warriors on military expeditions depended on others to relay their communications, and this hadith equates such service with the act of freeing a slave, one of the most meritorious deeds in Islam.
